# Newood Millwork Inc

> Custom cabinetry and architectural millwork manufacturer in Concord, Ontario. We design, build and install custom kitchens, closets and commercial millwork for homes and businesses across the Greater Toronto Area and Ontario.

## About
Newood Millwork Inc is a custom cabinetry and millwork shop at 450 Bowes Rd, Units 7-8, Concord, ON L4K 1K3 (Vaughan). Everything is measured, built and installed by our own team in our own shop — one company from design to completed project.

## What we make
- Custom kitchen cabinets and kitchen renovations (cabinetry, panels, islands)
- Custom closets and storage: walk-in closets, reach-in closets, wardrobes, mudroom built-ins (also under our Havenwest Closets brand)
- Commercial millwork: retail counters and cashier counters, store fixtures, office and restaurant millwork, supermarket and grocery fixtures
- Built-ins, wall units and pantries

## Service area
Based in Concord/Vaughan. Residential: Vaughan, Richmond Hill, Markham, Aurora, Newmarket, Toronto and the wider GTA. Commercial projects run across Ontario.

## How it works / lead times
- Every project is quoted individually after a design and site measure.
- Design & site measure fee: $399 + HST for a kitchen, $200 + HST for a closet — non-refundable, credited toward the order when you order within 90 days (closets up to $400 credit; kitchens up to $599 credit). The measure includes three rounds of drawing revisions.
- Timelines depend on scope and are confirmed in writing before we start; most kitchens are built and installed within weeks of design approval.

## Materials and hardware
Full-extension soft-close drawers, Blum hinges and lift systems; panels and finishes chosen per project and confirmed in the written quote.

## Pricing
Starting prices published on our website (estimates — the final price is confirmed in a written quote after the site measure):
- Custom kitchens: an 8-ft straight run starts from $7,000, including quartz countertop
- Reach-in closets: a 6-ft reach-in starts from $1,930
- Walk-in closets: a U-shape walk-in (8 x 6 x 6 ft) starts from $4,000
- Commercial millwork: priced per project after a site measure
Plus the design & site measure fees above.

## Estimates
- Published starting prices: https://newoodmillwork.com/kitchens.html and https://newoodmillwork.com/closets.html
- For a written quote, contact us through the website or by email — every quote follows an in-person design & site measure.
